catalog.title: Catalogue structure
catalog.intro: The catalogue describes documents in a hierarchy. Each level belongs to the next: archive, fund, inventory, case, document.

archive.label: Archive
archive.text: The institution that keeps the funds. The top of the hierarchy.

fund.label: Fund
fund.text: A set of documents from one source: an organisation or a person.

inventory.label: Inventory
inventory.text: A list of the cases within a fund.

case.label: Case
case.text: A group of documents united by a common feature.

document.label: Document
document.text: A single described item with a code and a date; a digital copy where available.

search.title: How to search
items: Type words in the search field: a title, a code, a surname or a place.
Narrow the results in the catalogue with filters: fund, period, document type, topic.
Open the document card: it shows the code, dates and the access status of the copy.

faqLink.title: Frequently asked questions
faqLink.text: Access statuses of copies, the meaning of codes and card fields are collected in the questions and answers section.

contactsLink.title: Branches and opening hours
contactsLink.text: Addresses, phones and working hours of the head archive and its branches.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.intro: Answers to common questions about the site and the electronic catalogue. The site provides no services: applications and orders are not accepted here.

readingRoom.title: Reading room
readingRoom.intro: The reading room is for viewing archive documents on site. Advance booking, ordering cases and submitting applications on the site are not provided.
readingRoom.hoursUnavailable: Please check the opening hours with the archive's contacts.
rules: Before your visit, check the reading room's opening hours and contacts.
Materials are viewed on site, in the reading room.
Follow the requirements for preserving documents and the instructions of staff.
The photography procedure and personal belongings are set by the reading room regulation.
